_note: The root craft: 2 stones and 3 hours of grinding after discovering the cliff; personal completion unlocks descendants even when another sharp tool is already owned.

log: You grind one stone against the other, hour after hour, until an edge comes up that cuts.
Three hours of grinding stone on stone. The edge is rough, but it cuts.
You knock flakes off one stone with the other, then grind the edge. It will never be a knife, but it will do.
